_doc: THE TRIP, directed per scene (2026-11-08). Built by tools/trip_direction.py from each scene's writing; GameEngine._trip_scene_start reads it. level = the scene_scale the scene opens at (0..1.5); register = an optional TripSync register; beats = a node where the trip swells or drops for `hold` lines. Hand-directed entries carry "locked": true and survive a rebuild. An inline [trip:] / [register:] cue on a line still wins there.
